svg.aria-label: Two panels. Today: four ways words reach a task. Reopen puts a finished task back to pending and overwrites its output; the coding door stops the attempt, parks and re-queues the row; answerTask answers a question; a line in an open task's session runs as a separate reply. After: one write, updateTask's message, kept on the task and read by every attempt. Before a start it joins the brief; a running request takes it before its next model call; a steer no request took gets one more turn; a coding run ends and the same request continues the coding session. It uses no attempt and is no ending. answerTask stays until FIX-2058. A strip below: a finished task. Today reopen overwrites its output. After, a steer is refused, a follow-up runs in the same session, the original output stays, and the task view shows the follow-up's output as current.

g.text: TODAY · FOUR WAYS IN
reopen
a finished task back to pending · its output overwritten
messageDoor · harnessMessageDoor
coding runs only · stop the attempt, park, re-queue
a reply beside the open task
a line in its session · not part of the task
answerTask
answers a question · stays until FIX-2058
struck: removed here · dashed: stays for now
a filer model has no way to steer at all
AFTER · ONE STEER, KEPT ON THE TASK
updateTask({ id, message })
until it finishes
Not started
joins the brief
Running
taken before the next model call
Untaken
one more turn before it settles (D2)
Coding run
run ends · same request continues
no attempt used · no ending · never a cancel
every later attempt reads it (D1)
A FINISHED TASK
Today
a message reopens it under the same id
its next attempt overwrites the output
its filer and dependents already used
After
a steer is refused, naming the rule
a follow-up runs in the same session · the original stays
the task view shows the follow-up's output as current (D3)
